selection: One common strength; largest candidate within one fleet standard error of the lowest development mean unobserved-speed matrix error. No primary outcomes enter selection.
objective: Mean squared local matrix-target loss plus strength times the trapezoidal average of squared second derivatives with respect to z=(v-20)/10, plus numerical ridge. Seven-function fixed LPV span, no L3 coefficient prior.
scope: Matched post-review local-baseline supplement, not independent confirmation. Reconstruct only the existing 10B partial calibration, verify Local/Global fleet means, save targets and references. Fit primary clients using frozen review targets; no group refits, new fleet seeds, or control rollouts. Development reference Jacobians are an offline tuning resource; primary reference Jacobians are evaluation-only.
